Fundamentals of Game Design

This module introduces students to the foundational concepts of game design, focusing on the formal elements and dramatic elements that define how games are structured and experienced.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Identify and explain the formal elements of game design (rules, systems, mechanics, objectives, feedback).

+  Analyse and apply dramatic elements (narrative, character, conflict, worldbuilding) in simple game concepts.

+  Describe key developments in the global and Vietnamese game industry, including major trends, genres, and platforms.

+  Analyse games using basic game design frameworks and vocabulary.

+  CLO5 Develop and communicate simple game ideas through basic design documentation and prototypes (e.g., paper prototypes).
